title: Missing Report-To response header
description: The response omits Report-To, so no reporting group is configured for this origin and CSP, NEL and deprecation reports have nowhere to go. The header is reporting infrastructure: its absence hides browser-side violations from the operator without weakening a control the browser enforces.
remediation: Define an HTTPS collector and send Report-To with a group name, a max_age and an endpoint, then reference that group from the policy that should report. If no collector exists, record the decision.
limitation: Header-name check on one response. It cannot tell whether reporting is configured by another mechanism, and it does not validate the endpoint.
